import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Define placeholder values to treat as null
    null_values = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

    def clean_str(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
        s = pl.col(col_name).str.strip_chars()
        return pl.when(s.is_in(null_values)).then(None).otherwise(s)

    return raw.select(
        supplier=clean_str("@Lieferant"),
        sku=clean_str("Artikel").str.to_uppercase(),
        description=clean_str("Bezeichnung"),
        unit=clean_str("Einheit").str.to_uppercase(),
        pack_size=clean_str("VPE")
        .str.replace_all(r"\s+", "")
        .cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        price=clean_str("Preis")
        .str.replace_all(r"^(EUR|USD|GBP)\s*", "", literal=False)
        .str.strip_chars()
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        currency=pl.lit("EUR"),
        valid_from=clean_str("Gueltig ab").str.to_date(
            format="%d.%m.%Y", strict=False
        ),
    )
